name: Ferrières
locality: arrondissement of Amiens, canton of Picquigny
text: Ferrières (French pronunciation: [fɛʁjɛʁ] ) is a commune in the Somme department in Hauts-de-France in northern France.

depictions.name: Ferrières
depictions.text: Ferrières was a large Frankish town build along the River Rhine in the eastern part of the region, just on the other side of the river from Wulfram Settlement. It featured a large number of houses and a church and was guarded by a significant military force. The old stone bridge between both locations at one point collapsed, separating the two cities.
